A.event: actual final observed cmd_vel linear changes nonzero to zero
A.scope: local topic receipt to sustained raw odom linear rest; no Gazebo receipt assumption

B.event: same-epoch native_cancel_call_attempt trace matching original native_send robot/goal
B.completion_required: subsequent original received delivery cancel=True or GoalStatus result=5, same epoch/robot/goal/source-clock≤receipt-clock and ≥attempt-clock
B.scope: call attempt→Nav2 cancel→smoother→actuator total sampled response; never sudden-zero proof
B.invalidation: next true native_send or nonzero-linear output after first zero, before 3 rest samples

shared.raw_limits: complete body-plane linear norm≤.30, complete angular norm≤1.2, consecutive raw-odom chord speed≤.30; all/task maxima reported separately
shared.credit: A and B separate per robot; either can supply sampled-range evidence, never conflate B with A; no meaningful prior movement means missing, not PASS

covers: meaningful B smooth cancellation without A credit
protocol intent is not native call
new native goal/linear recovery invalidates B
tiny movement and slow nonrest beyond horizon

intermediate_failure.stage: local helper extraction during A/B refactor
intermediate_failure.result: py_compile SyntaxError from leftover loop continue before any test/native data execution; removed; full final tests passed

scope: independent finite sampled response and strict-close consumer. Reports actual initial-speed coverage, no continuous unobserved path proof, no expansion of native budget.
